HMT and DR have a greater impact on the functional properties, SDS and RS content than ANN.

the digestibility of starch was influenced by crystal type and granule surface morphology while relative crystallinity influenced the pasting point.
the HMT and DR treatments have significantly modified the pasting and digestibility of banana flour.

the digestibility of banana flour starch can be improved by HMT and DR.
